x: Our team this year contained only three of the eight who did duty for us last year, the absentees being such well-known walkers as Tommy Green, Fred Rickards, Jack Bidgood, Bert Field and Bill Holman.

Our scoring team was completed by Bill Holman, who did well; and would be a first-class distance walker had he the necessary time to train. A word of praise to our lesser lights: Allen, Bicknell, Yorwarth, Laurie, Spooner, Wattam and Willis for their efforts.
